mapper.sql: r.id, r.order_id orderId, r.product_id productId, r.from_user_id fromUserId, r.to_user_id toUserId, r.star, r.content, r.is_default isDefault, r.create_time createTime, p.title productTitle, fu.nickname fromNickname, fu.avatar fromAvatar, tu.nickname toNickname
from review r left join product p on r.product_id = p.id left join user fu on r.from_user_id = fu.id left join user tu on r.to_user_id = tu.id
mapper.select:
select
where r.product_id = #{productId} order by r.id desc limit 100

select
where r.to_user_id = #{toUserId} order by r.id desc limit 100
